jobs.title: Strategic Research Associate
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Support corporate strategy discussions with structured market and competitive research. This role is designed for remote work within the United States, with collaboration through written updates and scheduled discussions.

Key Responsibilities

Gather credible market sources and reconcile conflicting figures.
Compare competitive positioning, customer segments and business-model assumptions.
Prepare research notes that highlight uncertainty and unanswered questions.
Create simple comparison tables and presentation summaries for senior review.

Qualifications And Working Skills

Strong desk research and analytical writing skills.
Ability to interpret spreadsheets and business performance indicators.
Careful citation, organization and source verification.

Expected work outputs

Produce balanced research briefs that make strategic assumptions transparent and easy to revisit.

Working standards

Maintain accurate notes, protect confidential information encountered in the role, communicate dependencies promptly, and seek review when a task requires an approval or specialist judgment. Work should be traceable to source information and completed against agreed priorities.
